function.name: soccer_stats_get_last_match_result
function.description: Retrieve the results of the most recent match between two football teams. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team1.description: The name of the first team.

team2.description: The name of the second team.

season.description: The football season in question (Optional). Default: 'spring'

message.content:

1. **目前正在進行的西甲比賽有哪些？**  
2. **某兩支球隊最近一次對決的結果？**
